articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Influencing Factors of the P2P Lending Investment Behavior of Chinese College Students
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: P2P lending investment behavior of college students is affected by many factors. According to the purpose of the survey, the characteristics of the students and the characteristics of the P2P lending industry, this paper uses the data collected by questionnaires as the original data and refines the main influencing factors of P2P lending investment behavior of college students, then this paper builds the behavioral influence factor model of P2P lending investment of college students , and uses structural equations to do the fitting analysis of model and survey data and tests the hypothesis. According to the result of empirical research: Perceived Value, Performance Expectancy and Effort Expectancy can significantly affect Investment Intentions; Performance Expectancy, Investment Intentions and Perceived Risks can significantly affect investment behavior; the influence of Society Influence on Investment Intentions are not obvious.

articleTitle: Combination Evaluation Based Private Partner Selection of PPP Mode for Brownfield Redevelopment Project
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: The limited funding has become a major dilemma for the redevelopment of brownfields. Public Private Partnership (PPP) mode has been highlighted as a potential resolution for this challenge. A suitable private partner plays an important role for the successfully utilization of PPP in BRP. This paper provides a combination methodology to select the most suitable one. In detail, the evaluation index system of the available private partners is designed first. After that, the implementation processes of three commonly used evaluation methods, including fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, grey relational evaluation and TOPSIS, are presented separately. Following the consistency validation, a combination evaluation methodology based on the above three methods is designed finally. A case study is used to certify the applicability and effectiveness of the combined methodology.

articleTitle: Optimization of Cost Plus Incentive Fee Contract in Equipment Acquisition Considering Cost Revelation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Currently, the cost plus incentive fee contract is commonly used in the field of equipment acquisition while it has some limitations. It may cause supplier to overstate cost to increase profits, and ultimately reduce efficiency in the use of funds. To motivate supplier to tell its actual costs, the model optimizes the cost plus incentive fee contract and proposes that the target cost be set by the supplier rather than the customer. Correspondingly, target profit and incentive coefficient are set based on the target cost set by the supplier. The optimization model gives the specific function of target profit and incentive coefficient on target cost, and limits the range of profits by setting the upper limit and the specific value at the most likely cost of profit rate. In theory and case, it is demonstrated that the supplier benefits the most when telling its actual cost, and the contract can achieve the optimal incentive effect.

articleTitle: Research on the Development Trend of Internet of Things —— Based on Bibliometrics and Visualization Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Bibliometrics and knowledge map visualization methods were used to quantitatively and qualitatively analyze the recent 15 years of academic papers in the field of Internet of Things in the web of science(WOS) database. From the five aspects of time series, national and regional distribution, journal distribution, high-yield authors, research hotspot and research frontiers, we analyzed the overall research status of academic papers in the field of Internet of Things in the past 15 years in order to understand and grasp the development trends of the Internet of Things. This will have important implications for understanding and analyzing the development trends in the field of Internet of Things and promoting the deepening and internationalization of research in the field of Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Study on the Emergency Material Allocation from the Perspective of Cross-regional Rescue
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Emergency material allocation is essential to improve emergency rescue effectiveness and reduce disaster losses, which has become a research focus for emergency response. However, it is seldom given due consideration in disaster response from cross-regional rescue perspective. For this reason, the paper breaks the traditional regional emergency rescue mode and proposes a cross-regional emergency material allocation model with the goal of the lowest transportation costs, the shortest delivery time and the maximum satisfaction of the victims. Finally, Numerical experiment and analysis are conducted to demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed model. The results show that the proposed model can make the emergency material allocation more efficient and fair, and can provide method and decision support for the cross-regional emergency rescue.

articleTitle: Coupling and Coordination Development of Economy and Environment System: A Panel Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: In this paper, the index system of economy subsystem and environment subsystem was constructed through coupling coordination degree model and PLS method. The coupling and coordination development level of economic growth and environment system(ECEV) in 30 provincial-level regions of China was estimated, and an empirical analysis of the influencing factors was carried out. The results showed that there are obvious regional differences in the coupling coordination degree of the ECEV system in 30 China's provinces. The high coupling and coordination developed areas included the Eastern and Middle regions such as Beijing, Shanghai, Guangdong and so on, and the middle and low coupling and coordination developed provinces more distributed in the Western region from 2004 to 2014; the coupling coordination degree of provincial ECEV system showed a dynamic upward trend; the technical progress had a positive relationship with the coordination degree of the ECEV system; energy technology level and environmental regulation have a positive effect on the coordination degree of ECEV system.

articleTitle: Dynamic Structure Embeddedness Process of Stakeholder Relationship Network in Brownfield Regeneration Based on Sequential Game Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Considering earlier studies of stakeholder relationship network structure embeddedness mainly on static state, this paper describes the dynamic structure embeddedness process of brownfield regeneration stakeholder relationship network using the sequential game model. The results show that “high trust” is the sufficient condition for stakeholder who is at relationship network edge to deeply embedded into the relationship network by relationship transitivity and the reciprocity preference of stakeholder is the critical factor for improving relationship network structure embeddedness.

articleTitle: Research on the Evolution of Network Group Behavior Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Model
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Group behavior under the network environment is complex, and the evolution trend is the result of various factors' interaction, so it's hard to master. How to evaluate the evolution of network group behavior is an important part of social crisis management research. But so far, scientific quantitative assessment method has been seldom. This paper introduced the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. Then, the evaluation index system of network group behavior evolution was constructed, and the evaluation model of network group behavior evolution situation was set up through the analysis of behavior characteristics and evolution process of network group, which provided a new way to study the uncertainty, fuzziness and dynamics in the evaluation of network group behavior evolution.

articleTitle: Third-party Reverse Logistics Supplier Optimization Method Based on TFN-AHP and Entropy Combination Model
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the advantages of the third-party reverse logistics, this paper proposed a new modeling method of combining TFN-AHP and entropy aiming at the hot issues of third-party reverse logistics supplier selection. The model comprehensively considered the advantages of subjective and objective weightings, introducing a concept of triangular fuzzy numbers (TFN) in the evaluating process, which could overcome the inherent flaws of traditional analytic hierarchy process (AHP). This method can determine the third-party reverse logistics supplier evaluation indicators system scientifically and solve the supplier optimization problem, owning a high credibility.

articleTitle: A Meta-analysis of the Influence Between Entrepreneurial Orientation and Firm Performance
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: This thesis will apply meta-analysis to the research of the influence between entrepreneurial orientation and firm performance, through the collection of domestic and foreign relevant bibliographic database for nearly 30 years, we got 143 articles mainly in top journals home and abroad and finally got the meta-analysis research with a total of 99 literatures. In the study, entrepreneurial orientation is divided into five dimensions with innovation, proactiveness, competitive aggressiveness, risk-taking and autonomy. Based on this, the study adds country attributes, eastern and western cultural differences, enterprise age and staff size as regulating variables, to study the influence of the variables on the influence between entrepreneurial orientation and business performance. The results show that entrepreneurial orientation promotes firm performance, and country attributes, eastern and western cultural differences, enterprise age and staff size regulate the influence above. Finally, according to the results of the hypotheses, suggestions are put forward.

articleTitle: Research on the Sustainable Transfer of Tacit Knowledge in University Innovative Teams
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: In order to achieve sustainably transfer of tacit knowledge in university innovative teams, the paper analyzed the necessity and the process of tacit knowledge transfer and built a differential dynamic model. By solving the model's equilibrium point and analyzing the stability, the basic condition of the sustainable transfer was given: contact efficiency was greater than the loss rate. Based on this, the sustainable transfer of tacit knowledge could be achieved by building a technical platform, establishing an incentive mechanism, and creating the team culture atmosphere.

articleTitle: A Framework of an Intelligent Recommendation System for Particle Swarm Optimization Based on Meta-learning
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Particle swarm optimization has shown great advantages to solve NP-hard problems due to its simplicity, intelligence, efficiency and easy enhancement. However, with a large number of particle swarm optimization variants (PSOs) proposed, there are two issues: First, are the general problems of PSOs in terms of premature convergence, universality and robustness solved thoroughly? Second, how to find the relatively appropriate PSOs in a quick and efficient way when facing real-world complex optimization problems? Therefore, it is so necessary to develop an intelligent recommendation system for PSOs to provide users a black-box tool for various application problems.

articleTitle: The Relationship between Entrepreneurial Self-Efficacy and Entrepreneurial Intention
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: This study examines the effects of the relationship between entrepreneurial self-efficacy and entrepreneurial intention. The empirical results from a survey of 644 Chinese students show that (1) entrepreneurial self-efficacy has a significant positive effect on entrepreneurial intention; (2) entrepreneurial attitude has a significant positive impact on entrepreneurial intention; and (3) entrepreneurial attitude fully mediates the relationship between entrepreneurial self-efficacy and entrepreneurial intention. The results challenge several findings of the existing research and provide a theoretical basis for enhancing university students' entrepreneurial intentions.

articleTitle: Research on Online Shopper Behavior Pattern Based on a Dynamic Architecture Neural Networks and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: With the development of Internet, electronic commerce develops rapidly and grows strong. Today, it is very important for consumers to buy products by online shopping. Particularly, more and more consumers do shopping by mobile. However, the many researches indicate consumers often access the websites for shopping, and they give up their purchase viewpoint in the end. What factors influence consumer's willingness to buy? To solve the problem, a novel and efficient algorithm is presented in this paper. The algorithm is excellent in modeling dynamic architecture by neural networks. In addition, a data mining algorithm which extracts relational rules from data records is proposed too. Genetic algorithm is used in this mining algorithm. Most of traditionary neural network architectures are arbitrary. Before train of neural network, firstly, the algorithm fixes the number for hidden layer and node. However, in this new algorithm, the numbers are dynamically produced. Moreover, the paper presented a novel genetic algorithm whose computation is simple. The optimal values of chromosome (input attributes), x<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub>, is found by use of the genetic algorithm. The achieved results confirm the presented algorithms are efficient and novel.

articleTitle: Research on Incentive of National Defense Intellectual Property’s Conversion and Application in Weapon Equipment’s R&D Process
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: In view of the low conversion and application rate (CAAR) of national defense intellectual property (NDIP) and the notable repeated R&D phenomenon in weapon equipment procurement process, effective incentive to promote the CAAR of China's NDIP is studied from the perspective of evolutionary game. The incentive intensity of NDIP is defined in the form of "giving more R&D opportunities". Based on the duopoly R&D competetion hypothesis and the replicator dynamic model, evolutionary model of the R&D strategy of the two equipment R&D enterprises under certain incentive intensity value is constructed .The incentive intensity of NDIP is defined from the perspective of "giving more R&D opportunities". Analysis of the existence and stability of stationary points shows that there are two critical values of the incentive intensity of NDIP on effecting the evolutionary stable strategy combination of the two competitive R&D enterprises, and the incentive effect is discrepant in different value ranges: (1) when the incentive intensity is lower than the first critical value, incentive is invalid; (2) when incentive intensity lies between the two critical value, given other conditions, the possibility of "applicate NDIP" into an evolutionary stable strategy increases with the increase of incentive intensity; and (3) when the incentive intensity exceeds the second critical value, "applicate NDIP" becomes the only evolutionary stable strategy.

articleTitle: Does the New Generation of Employees Have a Strong Impact on Organizational Commitment?
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: The impact of work reshaping on employees' work attitude and behavior has always been the focus of management. In this study, a questionnaire survey was used to select 418 employees from a scientific and technological enterprise to explore the impact of work reshaping on organizational commitment, and to analyze the role of leadership empowerment in it. The results show that the social work resources and the challenging work requirements in the work reshaping have a more obvious positive predictive effect on employee organizational commitment. The degree of leadership empowerment will regulate the relationship between social work resources, challenge work demands and organizational commitment. Under the leadership of high empowerment, employees' social work resources and challenging work demands make the organizational commitment increase significantly. On the other hand, the lower level of leadership will reduce the social work resources of the new generation employees and the impact of challenging job demands on organizational commitment.

articleTitle: Patent Quality Evaluation with Entropy Weight Method and Improved TOPSIS: The Case of Geriatric Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Evaluating the quality of patents and identifying high-quality patents from numerous patents can promote economic activities such as patent transfer, acquisition and custody, and pledge financing; assisting enterprises to understand the status quo of technology development, determine R&D direction, defend themselves against patent trolls and product infringement. In order to evaluate patent quality simply and effectively, a patent quality evaluation model based on entropy weight method and improved TOPSIS is proposed. First, the evaluation indicator system for patent quality were established, which included 5 categories and a total of 11 indicators. Then, the weights of each indicator were calculated by entropy method. Finally, we employ the improved TOPSIS and traditional TOPSIS to calculate the ranking of performance for each patent, and then compare the results of these two methods to verify the superiority of the improved method. The suggested methodology was applied to the Geriatric technology. The identifying of high quality patents is of a great significance to decision makers and can also serve as a useful reference for future studies, which may be of a great interest to the general audience.

articleTitle: Industrialization and Economic Growth in China: A Panel Test of Kaldor’s Growth Laws
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: China has experienced sustained and rapid economic growth since its reform in 1978. Researchers have cast lots of attentions to explain China's economic growth and attributed it to the rapid growing manufacturing in the process of industrialization. Regional economic growth and industrialization process in China from 1978-2016 are shown in this paper. Using province panel data, this paper explores the relationship between total output growth and manufacturing growth based on Kaldor's laws to answer whether manufacturing is the engine of economic growth. The regression results confirm all hypotheses in Kaldor's growth laws. Positive relationship between manufacturing and GDP growth is confirmed. Increasing returns to scale is verified in manufacturing. Employment from non-manufacturing to manufacturing can improve the labor productivity and growth rate of total output.

articleTitle: The Influence of Knowledge Cooperation on Enterprise Innovation Performance in Innovation Network ——The Moderating Effect of Network Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Knowledge cooperation based on network platform is an important approach for enterprises to gain competitive advantage. This paper based on the social network theory and value creation theory, explores the influence of knowledge cooperation on enterprise innovation performance, and introduces network characteristics as situational variables .The network characteristics are divided into two dimensions: network position and network relationship. This paper studies network position, network relationship and the interaction of both how to moderates the knowledge cooperation and innovation performance. Using 53 high-end equipment manufacturing enterprises in Shanghai as a sample, the empirical study is carried out by hierarchical regression analysis and three-way interaction analysis. The results show that, knowledge cooperation has the positive effect on enterprise innovation performance. Network position moderates the relationship between knowledge cooperation and enterprise innovation performance in a flat inverted-U function. Network relationship positively moderates the relationship between knowledge cooperation and enterprise innovation performance. The interaction between network position and network relationship moderates the relationship between knowledge cooperation and firm innovation performance in a sharp inverted-U function.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence Mechanism of Information Overload of University Users on Library Performance——Based on Empirical Research of Moderating Effect Model of Information Literacy and Knowledge Structure
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Based on the problem of information overload in the context of "Double First-class" university construction, this research explores the role of university users' information overload in influencing library performance from the coordination between information behavior and information resources. Specifically, this research analyzes the moderating effect of university users' information literacy and knowledge structure on the relationship between information overload and library performance, taken 10 "Double First-class" universities as the research object. The results show that the information overload of university users is negatively correlated with the library performance, and the information literacy and knowledge structure are positively correlated with the library performance respectively. Based on this, the information literacy and knowledge structure respectively moderate the relationship between information overload and library performance. That is, under the strong information literacy or knowledge structure, information overload has a weaker negative impact on library performance. Finally, the discussion results and suggestions are given to promote the university library in the performance management to ensure the effective coordination between the users' information behavior and information resources.

articleTitle: Study on the Environmental Innovation Capability Evaluation Model of Manufacturing Enterprises Based on Entropy Weight TOPSIS-BP Neural Network and Empirical Research
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: In order to objectively and accurately evaluate the environmental innovation capability of manufacturing enterprises, this study establishes an evaluation indicator system of environmental innovation ability of manufacturing enterprises. We propose the evaluation model of environmental innovation capability of manufacturing enterprises based on the integrated learning algorithm which is entropy weight TOPSIS and BP neural network. First, the entropy weight method is employed to calculate the weighted index and comprehensive evaluation of environmental innovation capability of manufacturing enterprises by TOPSIS method. Then, the evaluation value is used as a priori sample for the training and testing of BP neural network. The environmental innovation ability of the manufacturing enterprises is analyzed and evaluated in a more comprehensive way. Furthermore, an empirical evaluation of the sixty enterprises in Heilongjiang Province is taken as the example to illustrate the feasibility of this method. And the environmental innovation capability of enterprises is comparatively analyzed. The validity of the prediction model was verified by comparing the proposed the entropy weight TOPSIS-BP neural network regression fitting algorithms. The results show that the evaluation results based on entropy weight TOPSIS-BP neural network model is more accurate and reliable than the existing methods. In addition, it provides theoretical suggestions for further improving the environmental innovation capability of manufacturing enterprises in China.

articleTitle: Optimization Model for Multi-facet Requirement Service Chain Oriented Integrated Maintenance Plan
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Aiming at maintenance service chain with multiple service point requirement, this paper proposes an integrated maintenance plan optimization model in the condition of equipment maintenance by outsourcing companies. It analyzes resource allocation under multiple service point requirement from the perspective of service providers, explores the method of reasonable allocation of service personnel and devices used for maintenance under the circumstance of maintenance by outsourcing companies while meeting the constraint of different duration in multiple service points, and builds a resource allocation optimization model in multiple service points from the viewpoint of service demand enterprise. The model takes into consideration such constraints as service provider's trust degree, service duration, service cost and resource tightness, and proves with cases the effectiveness of resource allocation optimization model in multiple service points.

articleTitle: Exploring the Influencing Factors of the Diffusion of Electric Vehicles Sharing Service in Shanghai Using Fuzzy Cognitive Maps
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: With the increasing of environmental pollution, traffic jams and parking problems, people have begun to look for low-carbon travel ways. At the same time, the development of information technologies such as mobile internet, third-party payment, and GPS positioning, has provided a foundation for the emergence of travel sharing services. As a new industry, the diffusion of travel sharing services in cities is the focus of enterprises and government. This article takes the electric vehicle sharing service as an example to carry out the study. Starting from government, enterprises and the users, we collect and analyze the factors that affect the diffusion of the electric vehicle sharing service. Fuzzy cognitive map is a technique for analyzing complex decision-making problems and we use it to identify the key factors affecting the diffusion of electric vehicle sharing service in this study. Simulations of the diffusion is based on the current state of electric vehicle sharing service in Shanghai. The results show that different stakeholder groups have different views and identify different factors as driving factors for the diffusion of electric vehicle sharing services. The simulations have indicated that the model developed based on fuzzy cognitive maps is more sensitive to political factors.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Technology Innovation Efficiency and Its Influencing Factors of Chinese High-tech Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: This paper uses stochastic frontier model to measure the technology innovation efficiency and influencing factors of high-tech industry in 28 regions in mainland China from 2010 to 2016. The results show that the technology innovation efficiency of Chinese high-tech industry is low, showing a state of fluctuation, and the efficiency of the invention patents authorization as output is higher than that of new product sales as output. There is a positive correlation between the scale of enterprises, the degree of market competition and technology innovation efficiency. There is a negative correlation between the government intervention and technology innovation efficiency. The proportion of the state-owned economy is negatively related to the efficiency of the patents as output, but is positively related to the efficiency of new product sales as output.

articleTitle: A Study on the Economic Effects of Provincial Capital Bias and the Adjustment of Urban Development Strategy in China
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Provincial capital has a significant status and influence on the development of regional economy as a focus of a province in China. This paper finds that the provincial capital bias, which is the ratio of a capital city's population in a province's population, embodies an increasing tendency in the migration of population using a panel data of 19 provinces from 2000 to 2016. Based on a theoretical analysis, this paper constructs regression models and studies the economic effects of provincial capital bias from 3 aspects. The results show: provincial capital bias promotes the growth of provincial economy significantly; provincial capital bias has no impact on the provincial income inequality; provincial capital bias provides a significant spread effect to surrounding regions. Therefore, China should adjust its urban development strategy to promote the population to further gather into the provincial capital cities.

articleTitle: Analysis of Five Clustering Algorithms in Quantitative Method Research
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: In the course of research using quantitative methods, cluster analysis is often used for scientific research. However, we often face some complicated clustering algorithms during the analysis process. Choosing the right clustering algorithm is a very necessary research issue. Therefore, based on the characteristics of adjacency matrix data, we analyze the commonly used clustering algorithms in scientometrics. Firstly, we analyze the procedure of clustering. Then, the characteristics of several common clustering algorithms are summarized. Third, based on the validity and correctness of clustering, the effect of clustering algorithms are discussed. Finally, we implement the algorithm by MATLAB, and make an empirical analysis of three data sets cases. According to the characteristics of clustering algorithm, the correctness of clustering and the validity of clustering, we choose the clustering algorithm suitable for our use.

articleTitle: Exploring an Innovative Student Satisfaction Study on Social Media: A Method Combing Satisfaction Theory with Natural Language Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: In the era of "Big data" and "Web 2.0", the viral speed of information dissemination magnified the data problem of subjectivity and timeliness in student satisfaction (SS) study. In this study, we conducted an innovative SS study based on a new data collection instrument which makes the data objective, timely, and even massive. Combining traditional Student Satisfaction Inventory (SSI) with frontier Natural Language Processing technology, we conducted the SS study based on social media. Instead of asking students to participate in, we used data mining and sentiment analysis technology to mine the existed data. Further, drawing from SSI, we proposed an SS analysis model using these collected data. To verify the validity of this method, we gave an empirical study.

articleTitle: Research on Manufacturing Business Model Based on Internet of Things——Take the Shipbuilding Industry as an Example
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of smart manufacturing strategy and the gradual deepening of corporate transformation, the application value of the Internet of Things has become increasingly prominent in industrial transformation. This article takes the shipbuilding industry as an example to study the application of Internet of things technology in the shipbuilding industry. The Internet of Things makes the entire life cycle of ship design, construction, operation and dismantling more intelligent and green, however, the shipbuilding industry in China still has problems with the design and production capacity of high-tech, high value-added ships and serious waste of pollution. This paper studies the mechanism of technological innovation, environmental dynamics, and business model in the shipbuilding industry under the context of the Internet of Things, and proposes specific countermeasures and suggestions for the development of shipbuilding industry in the context of the Internet of Things from both the government and the corporate level.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Efficiency of Chinese Makerspace Operation Based on Double-creation Background
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: In recent years, China's economy in the global economic downturn in the environment, still in a relatively rapid growth, and China launched a "mass entrepreneurship, innovation" policy is inseparable. At the same time, makerspace is a new generation of incubator platform which is put forward under the background of double creation, and the inefficient operation is the problem to be solved urgently. In this paper, the Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) method is used as the research tool, according to the statistic data of the latest 2017 China Torch Statistics Yearbook, this paper evaluates and analyzes the efficiency of the makerspace operation in 30 provinces and cities of China in 2016 from four aspects of technical efficiency, pure technical efficiency, scale efficiency and projection analysis. The results show that: the technical efficiency of 30 provinces and cities in China is 0.847, the overall level is good, but not DEA effective accounted for the total area of 63.33%, of which scale efficiency is the main cause of technical efficiency. On the other hand, there are 14 provinces with varying degrees of input redundancy or insufficient output, the number of practitioners, the number of working places, the number of entrepreneurial instructors and other aspects of the input redundancy is the main cause of the non-DEA effective. Based on the above conclusions, this paper mainly puts forward 4 key countermeasures for the Government and related enterprises to provide reference for the operation and management of the Chinese provinces and cities.

articleTitle: Community Assistance and Perceived Community Cohesion in the Mix-Income Community: The Moderating Role of Social Comparison
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: With the acceleration of China urbanization process, a large number of people have flocked from rural area to urban area. How to make this group better fit into the society is a very important issue, and community is the most basic foothold place for them. This study uses random interview data from low-income residents in the mix-income community to study the psychological social integration problem of low-income people, and discusses the impact of factors such as community assistance, perceived community cohesion, and social comparison on the social integration of low-income groups. We handed out a total of 450 questionnaires, 441 questionnaires were recovered, of which 428 valid questionnaires. A multivariate regression method was used to systematically analyze the influence mechanism of community assistance on perceived community cohesion, while social comparison was also included in the study model to examine its moderating effects between community assistance and perceived community cohesion.

articleTitle: The Impact of QFII Shareholding of Listed Companies on Earning Management
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: This paper is based on the theory of real earnings management, considering whether QFII become the top ten shareholders of listed companies as the breakthrough to establish the theoretical model. We collected data of A-share listed companies from 2013 to 2015 in stock exchange of Shenzhen and Shanghai as samples for empirical research. The results show that when the QFII reach a certain shareholding ratio, they will participate in corporate governance and restrain earnings management, especially the real earnings management. On the other hand, accrued earnings management has an alternative effect on real earnings management that when real earnings management is suppressed, corporates will shift to accrued earnings management. This paper has great significance on improving and developing QFII system, improving corporate governance and protecting the interests of small and medium investors.

articleTitle: CEO Media Appearance and Corporate Performance: Evidence from Social Media in China
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: CEO media appearance has a significant impact on corporate performance and corporate financial performance under traditional media environment. In the social media environment, because of its interaction and dissemination, besides the CEO media appearance, we may consider the media transmission and media sentiment on the CEO in social media. Through the fixed effect model, this paper analyzes the impact of CEO media appearance, media transmission and media sentiment on corporate performance and corporate financial performance in the social media environment. The results show that CEO media appearance, media transmission and media sentiment have a significant impact on corporate performance. There is a direct positive impact on media appearance and media transmission, thus the media sentiment has a negative impact on corporate performance. However, the above value has no general significant impact on corporate financial performance, except the EPS. This conclusion provides a reference for the management of CEO related news and corporate performance in social media environment.

articleTitle: Optimization Management of Charitable Organizations’ Participation in Social Assistance in China
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Social assistance is the basic guarantee for maintaining social stability, optimizing urban governance and promoting sustainable development. The participation of charitable organizations in social assistance is a trend around the world. However, charitable organizations start late in China. There are many difficulties for charitable organizations to participate in social assistance. In this paper, 36 representative charitable organizations are selected as samples, and the method of Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) is used to analyze the relative efficiency of charitable organizations' participation in social assistance during 2013-2016. The results show that although the overall efficiency of charitable organizations has been improved during the study period, the average efficiency is low. Further, the panel regression model is used to analyze the factors that affect Chinese charitable organizations' participation in social assistance. Based on the results, several measures are suggested to be taken to optimize charitable organizations' participation in social assistance, including enhancing fund-raising capacity of charitable organizations, increasing government's support, improving the quality of staff of charitable organizations, and strengthening the supervision of charitable organizations' participation in social assistance<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup>.

articleTitle: Research on the Regional Differences Decomposition and Convergence Mechanism of Internet Finance Development of Seven Regions in China
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Mainland China can be divided into seven regions: North China, East China, Northeast China, Central China, South China, Southwest China, and Northwest China. Based on the monthly data(March 2014 to December 2015)of Internet financial development index released by Ant Financial Services Group big data platform, this paper uses the Dagum, Gini coefficient and its decomposition method to decompose the regional differences between seven regions in the development of Internet finance. Based on spatial panel data regression model, this paper tests the σ convergence, β convergence. From March 2014 to December 2015, the overall regional development of Internet finance shows a declining trend. Differences in the North China is the biggest. The differences of inter-region is the main source of Internet financial differences. Internet financial development shows a typical σ convergence. Our study has important implications to narrow the regional differences in the development of Internet banking, and promote the coordinated development of Internet banking in different agglomerations.

articleTitle: Research on Influence Factors of Technological SME’S Customer LoyaltyBased on Micro Marketing
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Customer loyalty has a significant value for the growth of technological companies. Previous scholars have conducted research on nine industries in the United States. The survey results show that for every 5% increase in customer loyalty, the company's profits increase by 25%. The author studies the factors that influence the customer loyalty of SME in the context of micromarketing. The study finds out that interaction, customer experience, brand image and perceived risk all have impacts on customer loyalty. The order of influence ranked from big to small is interactive, customer experience, brand image and perceived risk. The author establishes an empirical model, and sends questionnaires to technological enterprises which use internet platform to keep customers to obtain data. This study expands the existing theories of customer loyalty's influence factors, and helps SME to adjust their marketing strategies and better use means of micromarketing to promote customer loyalty.

articleTitle: Carbon Information Disclosure of Paper Making Industry Based on Index Analysis Method and Its Impacts on Green Credit
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: In recent years, the concept of low carbon environmental protection has been popularized all over the world. The nineteen main party of the party put forward the idea of "speeding up the reform of the ecological civilization system and building a beautiful China". It also has an impact on the green credit of the government while promoting the deep development of the low carbon environmental protection concept. This paper uses the index analysis method to take the annual reports published by 11 listed companies in paper industry as an example for 2015-2017 years. First, it summarizes the related concepts and literature; Secondly, the paper analyzes the quantity and quality of carbon information disclosure of the listed companies in paper making industry; and finally, according to the sample data of the listed companies in the paper making industry in China, With the help of SPSS20, we can get some conclusions about the impact of carbon information disclosure on green credit.

articleTitle: Exploring Donors’ Online Charity Adoption Base on Trust on Information Adoption Process
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: With the development of internet technologies in daily life, online donation has turned to be a preferable path for most donors. Internet has developed to be an important medium for diffusing charity information. According to the exist research in this area, our study proposes a model of trust formation in online charity information, rooted in the information processing theory. The proposed model theorizes trust as a function of the structural quality of information and the expertise of the information source. Furthermore, this relationship moderated by users’ internet literacy ability which also plays important roles on the information determination. Overall, the results will explain substantial variance in trust and highlight the important but distinct roles that information quality, source expertise, and donor’s internet literacy ability play in determining an individual's decision to trust online charity information.

articleTitle: Measurement Model of the Construction Dividend of Megaprojects: A Case Study of the Guangle Expressway
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Investment in megaprojects has a construction dividend. Taking the megaproject, the Guangle Expressway, as a case, this paper uses panel data from 41 cities, in Guangdong, Hunan, and Jiangxi, from 2000 to 2016 to construct a construction dividend measurement and evolution model based on multi-stage dummy variables. The results of the study indicate that: (1) The Guangle Expressway has a comprehensive dividend across its entire lifecycle. It has a dividend effect on economic growth, the adjustment of industrial structure, and the attraction of the cities along its route, and this effect evolves positively; (2) The investment in and construction of the Guangle Expressway have a significant dividend effect on related industries in the region, including construction, industry, transportation, retail and catering, finance and insurance, and so, during the construction and operation period, it promotes the development of related industries. The research results provide a theoretical basis for the calculation of the construction dividend of megaprojects in China, and provide new ideas for megaproject investment decisions.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Changes in Fair Value, Separation of Control Right and Cash flow Right and Earnings Volatility
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Since the introduction of fair value, its application and economic consequences have become the focus of research. This paper investigates whether fair value changes have an impact on earnings volatility over 2009-2016 periods. The results find that fair value changes does have a significant positive effect on earnings volatility, in addition, the separation of the control right and cash flow right plays a positive regulatory role in state owned companies, but disaffinity results are found when considering the nonstate-owned companies.

Author Keywords: Control right and cash flow right separation

articleTitle: Research on Developing the Cultivation of Innovative Talents in China under the Fourth Industrial Revolution
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: With development of the fourth industrial revolution, the knowledge economy and digital economy continue to maintain rapid growth. The fourth industrial revolution comes quietly and rapidly, as a significant participant country, higher demands are placed for innovative talents in China. So research on innovative talents under the fourth industrial revolution has drawn increasing attention. This paper firstly describes the conception and characteristics of the fourth industrial revolution, and related review of the role of innovative talents. From perspectives of government, enterprises, universities and research institutes, the paper summarizes countermeasures for cultivating and assembling innovative talents based on the existing research of scholars. At last, the paper proposes related suggestions for cultivating innovative talents in the future combined with characteristics of the fourth industrial revolution.

articleTitle: The Performance Evaluation Research of Cold Chain Logistics Enterprises Based on BPNN Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Demand for cold chain logistics enterprises is growing to accommodate the growth of China's economy and the enhancement of Chinese people's living standard. However, the country's cold chain logistics industry remains backward, thus making it a major task that how to raise the enterprise performance. Firstly, the study has chosen 5 primary indicators and 19 secondary indicators pertaining to cold chain logistics enterprises to set up its performance evaluation framework. Secondly, based on the merits and demerits of the BPNN model structure and it's calculation method, the study identifies the network layers, stimulant functions, and study perimeters of the BPNN model, and constructs the BPNN model for the performance evaluation of cold chain logistics enterprises. Finally, the study uses MATLAB7.0 software to calculate the BPNN model, and utilizes sim functions to simulate and analyze the feasibility of the BPNN method for cold chain logistics enterprise performance evaluation. The study firstly introduces BPNN technology into the performance indicators evaluation of cold chain logistics enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on the Effect of Margin and Short-selling on the Volatility of Stock Price
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Since the introduction of margin trading in March 2010, the effect of margin trading on stock market volatility is always a hot topic. However, does margin trading stabilize stock market? What the effect in different lever period? The result of these studies is inconclusive. As one of the most important credit trading system, the margin trading provides a tool to avoid the market risks to investors. In Financial crisis, developed countries often take restrictive measures of margin trading to stabilize the market. From 2015 to 2016, the Chinese securities market has experienced a significant boom and crash, providing a precious natural opportunity for us to investigate the effect of margin trading in different lever period. The result shows that in the period of sharp leverage and de-leveraging, margin trading significantly heightened the stock market volatility. The finance load exchange heightened the stock market volatility, the securities load exchange exacerbated the stock market volatility. When the level in the reasonable interval, margin trading stabilized the stock market volatility. In this period, both finance and securities load exchange are stabilized the volatility. Therefore, regulatory authorities should be strengthen the supervision and regulation of the margin trading mechanism, the implementation of the policy of the margin trading, and it will play a positive effect to the market.

Author Keywords: Panel data approach for program evaluation

articleTitle: An Analysis of Heuristic Behavior in NIMBY Conflicts Based on Evolutionary Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: The accelerating process of urbanization has expanded the citizens' demands of integral NIMBY (Not-In-My-Back-Yard) facilities in their daily life, which in turn leads to a series of NIMBY conflicts, thus affected social stability as well as the effective construction of public facilities severely. The resistance feeling in the surrounding general public, who are the primary stakeholders of NIMBY facilities, is likely to make them misjudge the project, thus oppose the construction and operation of the project. To better depict the public's heuristic behavior in the decision-making process, this paper considering heuristic bias, presents an evolutionary game model between the public and the government. Then it analyzes the stable strategy according to replicator dynamics equation. Further, it aims to discuss the effect of heuristic bias coefficient, environmental loss compensation and financial compensation difference on the Evolutionary Stable Strategy (ESS) through MATLAB simulations. The results show that the existence of heuristic bias may turn the public's behavior from cooperation to resistance, while in the meantime, increasing the financial compensation difference can offset the impact of heuristic bias to a certain degree. Finally, this paper offers policy recommendations from the perspective of reducing heuristic bias and providing financial support, in order to ensure the construction and operation of NIMBY facilities smoothly while maximizing their social benefits.

articleTitle: Construction of Express Packaging Recovery Logistics System from the Perspective of Ecological Innovation —— Take Xinyang Normal University as an Example
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of e-commerce, college students as the first special consumer groups to accept new technologies, their frequent online shopping behavior has increased the number of expressage quantities on campus, and the amount of express packaging materials has grown correspondingly. Due to the lack of effective recycling channels, the waste of express packaging materials has become more and more serious. This paper aims at the present situation and combines with the survey of express packaging materials recovery in Xinyang Normal University, to put forward some feasible solutions from the perspective of ecological innovation.

articleTitle: The Impact of Economic Institutional Environment on CSR for Urban Employee Old Age Insurance
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: At present, the performance of corporate social responsibilities (CSR) in China is worrying. It does not perform its CSR for urban employee old age insurance well. Enterprises always evades their social responsibility of contributing to employee old age insurance. They uses various methods, such as false reports of the workers' number and the use sub-contract agencies. Enterprises do not have good self-discipline and morality to consciously perform their social responsibilities, and corporate economic institutional environment has not played a role in restricting companies from circumventing social responsibilities and cannot effectively prevent the company's moral hazard. Enterprises play a negative role in fulfilling CSR. This study will use CSR as lens to check the mechanism of how the institutional environmental constraints impacts on the fulfillment of CSR, and how to build a good economic institutional environment to guide and standardize enterprises in fulfilling their social responsibilities.

articleTitle: The Research on Synergic Model of Pliable Organization for a Large-scale Project Based on the Classical Grounded Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: We choose a large project which is the largest investment project in our country - Guang-le highway as the research caseand study the pliable organization operation mechanism. Based on the research paradigm of classical grounded theory, the open coding, selective coding and theoretical coding of the data were carried out 67 concepts, 13 categories and 5 main categories. The collaborative model of pliable organization of a large construction project was established based on the above research. The result has shown that, engineering strategies, internal management, external support, and information technology will cooperate to influence the changing of pliable organizational structure. Engineering strategies will be the driving factor of the changes of flexible organizations. Internal management, through the establishment of standardized systems and process management, reduces the uncertainty in the operation of the organization. Through the following-up auditing, public participation and competent authority guidance, external support creates a safe, regulatory external environment for the pliable organization. Through big data analysis technology and Internet technology, Information technology timely manage and control project risk, which provide powerful tool support for the evolution of pliable organization.

articleTitle: Microblog-Oriented Public "Mass Innovation and Entrepreneurship" Hotspot Identification and Sentiment Analysis and Policy Suggestions
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: In order to obtain a wider public view on the Mass Innovation and Entrepreneurship policy and provide the basis for perfecting relevant policies, this paper proposes the method of hotspot identification and emotion analysis based on microblog, that is, based on the definition of microblog heat, the method first screens out popular microblogs that arouses the social attentions; and then pre-process the microblog about "Mass Innovation and Entrepreneurship" of hot microblogs, identify hot words, construct co-word matrix and dissimilarity matrix with the hierarchical clustering method, thus identify the hotspot of hot microblogs on "Mass Innovation and Entrepreneurship". On the basis of extending the existing emotional dictionary, the emotion analysis method based on dictionary and rule is adopted to analyze the hotspots of microblog. The results show that the emotion classification method based on the extended emotional dictionary improves the accuracy by about 14% with respect to the emotion classification without emotional dictionary extension, and better effect is obtained. This method is applied in the analysis of the Mass Innovation and Entrepreneurship policy, which proves that the proposed public concerned hotspot identification analysis method and the emotion classification method are feasible, and the suggestion of perfecting the Mass Innovation and Entrepreneurship policy is put forward.
